title: SpiderLS: Leveraging Full ZX Reduction for Lattice Surgery Compilation
summary: Lattice surgery compilation plays a central role in translating fault-tolerant quantum programs into efficient surface code realizations, where both spatial and temporal resources directly determine the cost of execution. Recent work has demonstrated the benefits of using ZX-diagrams as an intermediate representation for lattice surgery compilation, enabling semantics-preserving transformations that reduce spacetime cost.
